svg.text: SageMaker Pipelines, ml-tooling account, private VPC subnets, network isolation on training
SageMaker Pipelines: the weekly fraud-model retrain, from point-in-time features to a registered candidate
set. Stops the run on failure.
on the same test month: recall
Rules: recall at budget +1 pt or more,
no segment worse by over 2 pts,
written to S3 for the drift job.
